description: Reorganize the manually written SQL queries used by the Studio dashboard within the pg-meta package. Create a new folder structure to group queries by product area and update all exports so they can be imported directly from the package's main index.
functional_requirements: Create a new folder structure within pg-meta to organize SQL queries by Studio product area (e.g., /sql/studio/[product]/*.ts)
Move all existing Studio-related SQL query files from their current locations into the new organized folder structure
Update the pg-meta package's main index file to export all query constants directly, enabling imports like `import { xxx } from '@supabase/pg-meta'`
Update all Studio dashboard files to use the new import pattern from pg-meta instead of local query files
Ensure all existing tests for the moved queries continue to pass in their new locations
